SELECT
FROM document WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND doc_name = #{docName} AND deleted = FALSE

SELECT d.doc_name, COALESCE(v.title, d.title) AS title, COALESCE(d.status, 'INGESTED') AS status, COALESCE(v.version, d.version) AS version, COALESCE(v_chunks.chunk_count, d.chunk_count) AS chunk_count, COALESCE(v.size_bytes, f.size_bytes) AS size_bytes, COALESCE(v.mime_type, f.mime_type) AS mime_type, d.created_at FROM document d LEFT JOIN document_file f ON f.document_id = d.id LEFT JOIN document_ingestion_version v ON v.document_id=d.id AND v.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND v.active=TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COUNT(*) AS chunk_count FROM document_chunk c WHERE c.document_id=d.id AND (c.document_version_id=v.id OR (v.id IS NULL AND c.document_version_id IS NULL))) v_chunks ON TRUE WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY d.created_at DESC, d.id DESC

SELECT d.id AS document_id, d.doc_name, COALESCE(v.title, d.title) AS title, COALESCE(d.status, 'INGESTED') AS status, COALESCE(v.version, d.version) AS version, COALESCE(v_chunks.chunk_count, d.chunk_count) AS chunk_count, COALESCE(v.file_name, f.file_name) AS file_name, COALESCE(v.mime_type, f.mime_type) AS mime_type, COALESCE(v.size_bytes, f.size_bytes) AS size_bytes, COALESCE(v.storage_path, f.storage_path) AS storage_path, d.created_at, d.updated_at FROM document d LEFT JOIN document_file f ON f.document_id = d.id LEFT JOIN document_ingestion_version v ON v.document_id=d.id AND v.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND v.active=TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COUNT(*) AS chunk_count FROM document_chunk c WHERE c.document_id=d.id AND (c.document_version_id=v.id OR (v.id IS NULL AND c.document_version_id IS NULL))) v_chunks ON TRUE WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.doc_name = #{docName} AND d.deleted = FALSE
